name: Compare
description: Allow customers can compare multiple products
project_description: Compare lets storefront visitors put several Arch products side by side. Product types are opted in with a 'Comparable' flag; comparable products then expose a compare checkbox (an extra display field / block) whose selection is kept client-side in the browser. The /compare-products page renders the selected products as a field-by-field comparison table using a configurable 'compare' view mode, grouped by field_group groups and highlighting same/different/empty values. A settings form controls the maximum number of items and the view mode used.
